tests.title: Standard user login via menu and session verification
tests.expected: User signs in cleanly with secret masking/redaction, session shows Log Out in drawer, and teardown signs out.

tests.title: Locked-out user sees account locked error banner
tests.expected: Attempting to log in as a locked-out user remains on Login and displays the locked-out error message.

tests.title: Sort catalog by price descending, inspect top product, and scroll catalog
tests.expected: Sorting reorders highest-priced item first, tapping opens Fleece Jacket detail, back returns to catalog, and scrolling locates Sauce Labs Onesie.
